note: Both sets read the five spanwise curves, but Set A contains several clear misreadings: it gives root relative thickness as 50% (curve starts at 100%), claims 100% thickness out to r/R=0.1, gives tip chord as 1.5 m (curve drops to ~0.6 m at r/R=1.0), states root twist as both 15 and 14 deg, and places twist at -1.0 deg near r/R=0.9 and -1.8 deg near 0.85 where the curve is near its -2.5 deg minimum. Set B gets the key anchors right (root twist 15 deg, root relative thickness ~95-100%, tip chord ~0.6 m, prebend 0 at root and -4 m at tip, pitch-axis location 50% at root and ~37-38% at tip) and its spanwise readings are mostly consistent with the plots. Set B's defects are the root thickness 50% claim, a twist of 0.0 deg at r/R≈0.8 (zero crossing is near 0.6), and one vague 'prebend 0 unspecified' duplicate, plus a few borderline readings. Both sets contain duplicated claims, but Set B is the more faithful extraction overall.
